sourceManifest.policy: GeoJSON plot layers are distributed as a separate immutable asset bundle. Static code and small evidence files remain in the site bundle.

staticArtifact.policy: Normal static artifacts include public site files, bounded viewport chunks, and small JSON/CSV downloads. Original full-layer GeoJSON is referenced by hash and excluded unless --include-gis-geojson is explicitly used.

releasePrerequisites.privacyBoundary: Natural-person names and addresses are not requested or stored.
releasePrerequisites.sourceRightsPolicy: Unknown source rights block publication/redistribution per docs/design/TRD.md.

githubPages.enablement: Dispatch .github/workflows/deploy-static.yml from refs/heads/main with deploy_pages=true and a non-empty per-run approval reference; Guardian bindings and github-pages environment approval are also required.
githubPages.privateRepositoryCaveat: Private repository Pages availability depends on GitHub plan/settings. This package does not enable Pages settings or make the repository public.
githubPages.gisGeojsonOptIn: GeoJSON is included only when workflow_dispatch input include_gis_geojson=true and repository variable REALTYPROOF_ALLOW_GIS_GEOJSON_ARTIFACT=true.

rollback.invariant: Immutable release manifests under downloads/releases/<release-id>/release.json are never overwritten with different content.
rollback.instruction: Rollback by updating downloads/active-release.json to the prior release metadata; do not delete evidence/version history.
